verification.precondition: An explicit source root contains a symlink whose target is a readable regular file.
verification.stimulus: Capture the symlink logical name through the production surveyctl source adapter.
verification.expectedSemanticState: Capture fails closed with SURVEYCTL_SYMLINK_FORBIDDEN before target bytes become admitted evidence.
verification.expectedEvidenceState: The test runner reports the literal assertion: surveyctl source capture refuses a symlink without reading its target
verification.forbiddenMutation: Source capture must not follow, normalize through, replace, or snapshot the symlink target.

behavior: surveyctl source capture refuses a symlink without reading its target
